MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
25003437
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. FO 1176424
AMWEST FUNDING CORP,. is the Plaintiff, and PAMELA FOGLIANI, ET ALS,. are Defendants, writ of executian for the sale of mortgaged premises dated 10/20/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ, to me directed and delivered, I will expose to sale at public vendue on WEDNESDAY, the 21ST DAY of JANUARY A.D. 2026, at the hour of one thirty o’ clock by the then prevailing (Standard or Daylight Saving) time, in the afternoon of the said day, at the Heldrich Hotel,
10 Livingston Ave, New Brunswick,
N.J, 08901.
The property to be sold is located in the , County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey
Premises commonly known as: 16 GREENHILL AVENUE, PARLIN, NJ 08859
Tax Lot: 7, Tax Black: 209.Q3 Dimensions (Appox.): GO feet wide By 106 feet long
Nearest Cross Street: THOMPSON PLACE
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE BY PUBLICATION .
The estimated upset amount for the scheduled sheriff sale is currently $526,235.80.
The upset price is not the same as a payoff or judgement redemption amount.
Property is occupied by unknown.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the SuperIor Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the upset to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of FOUR HUNDRED EIGHTY EIGHT THOUSAND SIXTY EIGHT DOLLARS AND TWENTY CENTS ($488,068.20) dollars more or less, plus interest together with the costs of this sale. THE UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to adjourn said sale from time to time subject only to such limitations or restrictions upon the exercise of such power as may be specially provided by law or rules of the Court. Sold subject to conditions of sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of bid in a certified check or official bank check at close of sale and the balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
KML Law Group, P.C.
701 Market Street, Ste 5000 Philadelphia PA, 19106
Attorneys
Dated: 12/23, 12/30/2025,
1/6/2026, 1/13/2026
($215.96)
